label: The modulo reservation table
subgoals: Reduce each operation's start time modulo the II
Place its resource use in that row of the table
Require every row to stay within the number of copies

label: Iterative modulo scheduling
subgoals: Start from the larger of ResMII and RecMII
Try start times from the earliest legal one until a free row appears
Evict and retry, or raise the II when the budget runs out

label: Stages, prologue and epilogue
subgoals: Divide the single-iteration length by the II and round up for the stage count
Compute the prologue as stages minus one times the II
Realize fill and drain with stage-valid bits
